title: Literary Design of Ephesians 3:14-21
caption: <bp-cite>Ephesians 3:14-21</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Ephesians (2019).
html:
14 For this reason,
I bow my knee to the Father,
15 from whom every family-clan
in the heavenlies and on the earth
is named,
16 so that he would give to y’all,
according to the richness of his glory,
power to be strengthened
through his Spirit
in your inner human,
17 that the Messiah would dwell
in your hearts
through faith,
having been rooted
and established
in love
18 so that y’all would be empowered
to comprehend
along with all of the holy ones
what is the width and length and height and depth—
19 to know the
far-beyond knowing
love of the Messiah
so that y’all would be filled up
unto all the fullness of God.
20 Now to the one who is powerful
beyond all things
to do overabundantly more
than what we would ask or conceive,
according to the power which is at work in us,
21 to him be glory
in the church
and in Messiah Jesus
for all generations of the age of the ages, amen.
